mapper.select:
SELECT cust.company_code, cust.cust_code, cust.cust_name, cust.ceo_name, cust.bno, cust.btype, cust.bitem, cust.phone, cust.fax_no, cust.cust_email, cust.zonecode, cust.address, cust.address_detail, cmCode.code "custTypeCode", cmCode.code_name "cust_type", cust.dept, cust.user_name, cust.use_status, cust.created_by, cust.create_date, cust.updated_by, cust.update_date FROM tb_cust_master cust JOIN tb_cm_code cmCode ON cust.cust_type = cmcode.code
AND cust.cust_name LIKE '%' || #{custName} || '%'
AND cmCode.code = #{custType}
AND cust.use_status = 'Y'
ORDER BY cust.use_status DESC, cust.cust_code DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cust_master (company_code, cust_code, cust_name, ceo_name, bno, btype, bitem, phone, fax_no, cust_email, zonecode, address, address_detail, cust_type, dept, user_name, use_status, created_by, create_date) VALUES ('SAMPLE_COMPANY', FN_MAKE_CUST_CODE, #{custName}, #{ceoName}, #{bno}, #{bType}, #{bItem}, #{phone}, #{faxNo}, #{custEmail}, #{zonecode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{custType}, #{dept}, #{userName}, #{useStatus}, '박봉근', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT company_code, cust_code, cust_name, ceo_name, bno, btype, bitem, phone, fax_no, cust_email, zonecode, address, address_detail, cust_type, dept, user_name, use_status, created_by, create_date, updated_by, update_date FROM tb_cust_master WHERE cust_code = #{custCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_cust_master SET cust_name = #{custName}, ceo_name = #{ceoName}, bno = #{bno}, btype = #{bType}, bitem = #{bItem}, phone = #{phone}, fax_no = #{faxNo}, cust_email = #{custEmail}, zonecode = #{zonecode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, cust_type = #{custType}, dept = #{dept}, user_name = #{userName}, use_status = #{useStatus}, updated_by = '박수수', update_date = SYSDATE WHERE cust_code = #{custCode}
